title: Micro-Manager camera managerProperties
description: One Micro-Manager Camera device presented as an ImSwitch2 detector. System-config mode: 'label' names a camera the hub's .cfg loaded. Inline mode: 'adapter' and 'device' make the manager load the camera itself under 'label' (and unload it when it finalizes). Mono cameras only.

rs232device.description: Name of the 'micromanager.core' entry in rs232devices that owns the MMCore this camera lives in.

label.description: Micro-Manager device label. System-config mode: a Camera device the hub's .cfg loaded (a typo is reported with the list of loaded cameras). Inline mode: the label the new device gets.

adapter.description: Inline mode: Micro-Manager device adapter library (for example 'DemoCamera'). Must be given together with 'device'; leave both out when the .cfg already loads the label.

device.description: Inline mode: device name inside the adapter (for example 'DCam'). Must be given together with 'adapter'.

parent.description: Inline mode: label of the hub device (Micro-Manager Hub) the camera hangs off, when the adapter needs one.

preInitProperties.description: Inline mode: properties that can only be set before the device is initialised (Micro-Manager 'pre-init' properties), applied in order before initialisation.

cameraPixelSizeUm.description: Optically effective (sample-plane) pixel size of the unbinned camera in micrometres. Wins over Micro-Manager's pixel-size configuration, which is used (divided by the binning) when this is omitted; without either, ImSwitch2's 0.15 um placeholder applies and is flagged as an assumed default.
